title: Snake-in-the-box in dimension 13
statement: Find an induced path in the hypercube Q_13 (two of its vertices adjacent only when consecutive) with as many edges as possible. The longest known, by Toner (2026), has 2946 edges; a longer one improves it.
submission: Text file: the transition sequence from the vertex 0, one character per edge for the coordinate that changes (0-9, then a-z; whitespace ignored).
score: the number of edges (larger is better)

best_known.source: snake of length 2946 in Q_13: Toner (2026), on the snake-in-the-box records page (T. Ace, minortriad.com/snake) and in Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit 4521e13 (8 Nov 2026); read 8 Nov 2026
